details.about_story:
TeeBravo brings printed designs to T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts and accessories for customers in the United States.

Browse by interest or occasion, choose a design, then pick the product, color and size that suit you. Each item is printed after you order. The product page lists the available materials, colors, sizes and price for your selection.

TeeBravo is based in Hanoi, Vietnam. Please review the product details and size guide before checkout. If an item arrives damaged, has a print defect or does not match your order, email us and we will review the issue under our Returns & Refunds policy.
details.restrictions: We ship to the United States only. We do not impose additional destination restrictions within the United States. International shipping is not available.
details.returns_eligibility:
If an item arrives damaged, has a manufacturing or printing defect, or differs from your order, you may choose a free replacement or a refund after we verify the issue. This includes receiving the wrong design, garment, color or size, and a garment whose measurements fall outside the tolerance stated in its size guide.

Every item is printed to order. We do not accept returns or exchanges for a change of mind, a size or color you selected incorrectly, or a fit preference when the item matches the order and published size guide. Please check the measurements before ordering. Normal wear, misuse and damage caused by washing contrary to the care instructions are not covered. These limits do not remove any rights you have under applicable consumer law.
details.returns_window: Email us within 30 calendar days after delivery to report a damaged, defective or incorrect item. This is the deadline to contact us, not a deadline to send anything back. If a shipment has not arrived, contact us as soon as the latest estimated delivery date has passed, preferably within 30 calendar days of that date, so we can investigate. Statutory rights and remedies are not limited by these reporting periods.
details.returns_method:
Email help@teebravo.com with your order reference, the email used at checkout and a short explanation. For a damaged, misprinted or incorrect item, include clear photos of the item and the problem; include the size label and a measurement photo if the issue concerns size. If you cannot provide photos, tell us so we can discuss another way to assess the problem.

We review the order and evidence and email you the outcome or any questions. Once a claim is approved, you can choose a replacement at no charge or a refund. If a replacement is unavailable, we will issue a refund. You do not need to return an item for an approved claim. Keep it until we finish reviewing the issue, and do not mail items to our business address. Replacement production and transit follow the estimates in our Shipping Policy.
details.returns_fees: There is no claim fee, restocking fee or return shipping charge for an approved damaged, defective or incorrect-item claim. We pay the cost of the replacement and its shipping. If you choose a refund, we refund the affected item's purchase price, applicable tax and the shipping paid for that item. If the whole order is affected or cancelled by us, we refund the full amount paid, including shipping and applicable tax. We do not require a physical return.
details.refund_timing: We submit approved refunds to the original payment method within 2 business days of approval and email you when we have done so. Your bank or card issuer may take an additional 5 to 10 business days to post the credit. We do not substitute store credit for a refund. If the credit has not appeared after that time, contact help@teebravo.com so we can help trace it. Any shorter deadline required by applicable law takes priority.
details.privacy_details:
Technical information
Our hosting services process technical information such as IP addresses, browser details, requested pages and error logs to deliver the website, troubleshoot problems and protect it from misuse. We use order, payment and support records to fulfill purchases, handle claims, prevent fraud and meet accounting or legal obligations.

Service providers
We disclose information needed for these purposes to payment processors such as Stripe, production and fulfillment partners, shipping carriers, hosting providers and email or support services. For example, a fulfillment partner needs the ordered items and delivery details to ship your parcel. Stripe handles payment information under its own privacy policy at https://stripe.com/privacy. We do not store full payment card numbers or card security codes in our store database. We may disclose records when required by law or to resolve fraud, payment disputes or legal claims.

Cookies and choices
We use a shopping-cart cookie and store your chosen display theme. Where a cookie preference prompt is shown, we also remember that choice. You can clear local storage and cookies or block them in your browser, although blocking essential cookies may prevent the cart or checkout from working. The current storefront does not use advertising pixels or third-party analytics trackers. We will update this policy and provide any required choices before introducing them. We do not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising.

Retention and international processing
We keep personal information for as long as needed to fulfill orders, provide support and meet applicable recordkeeping duties. Records needed for tax, fraud prevention or a dispute may be retained after an order is completed or a deletion request is made. We delete or de-identify information when it is no longer needed. TeeBravo is based in Vietnam; information may be processed there and in countries where our service providers operate, including the United States. We use safeguards required by applicable law for international transfers.

Your requests
Email help@teebravo.com to request access, correction or deletion of your personal information, or to ask about other rights available under the law that applies to you. We may need to verify your identity using information associated with your order. Do not send a password or full payment card details. We respond within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful reason we cannot complete a request. We do not discriminate against customers for exercising privacy rights. If applicable law gives you a right to appeal a decision, reply to our response to request a review.

Children and security
The store is intended for adults making purchases, including adults buying children's clothing. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child has provided personal information. We use reasonable safeguards to protect information, but no online service can promise absolute security.

Policy changes
We may update this policy when our practices change. The version displayed here describes our current practices; we will provide additional notice where required by law.
details.terms_conditions:
Placing an order
You must be legally able to enter a purchase agreement or have authorization from a parent or guardian. Provide accurate contact and delivery details and use a payment method you are authorized to use. A payment confirmation records your transaction; we may still need to resolve an unavailable item, an obvious listing error or a suspected unauthorized payment before production. If we cannot fulfill your order, we will notify you and refund the amount paid for the cancelled items, including their shipping and applicable tax. We will not charge a higher corrected price without your agreement.

Changes and cancellations
Email help@teebravo.com as soon as possible to request a cancellation or a change to the size, color or delivery address. We can make changes or cancel with a full refund if production has not started. Once production begins, we cannot accept change-of-mind cancellations or guarantee changes. This does not affect remedies for faulty goods, our shipping-delay obligations or other rights under applicable law.

Product descriptions
Read the garment details and size guide for the product you choose. Fit and materials can differ between garments. Images illustrate the design and placement; screen settings and the printing process may cause minor color differences. This does not excuse a materially different item, an incorrect print or a manufacturing defect.

Delivery and problems
Processing and transit estimates are set out in our Shipping Policy. Express shipping does not bypass production. If we cannot ship within the stated processing period, we will contact you with a revised estimate and the option to cancel for a full refund, and obtain consent to a delay where required. We remain your point of contact for delivery problems and approved replacement or refund claims. Our Returns & Refunds policy applies to damaged, defective and incorrect items and explains the limits on non-defective returns.

Using the website
Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, submit fraudulent orders or interfere with other customers. Buying a product does not grant a license to reproduce or commercially use its artwork, photographs or other protected content. Intellectual property remains with its respective rights holders. Send an infringement concern to help@teebravo.com with enough detail for us to identify the material and review your claim.

Consumer rights and disputes
These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including rights relating to faulty or misdescribed goods. We do not require you to waive those rights or agree to mandatory arbitration. Contact help@teebravo.com first if there is a problem so we can work toward a resolution. Applicable law determines any additional rights and the courts with jurisdiction.

Updates
The purchase terms in effect when you place your order apply to that order. Later changes apply to future purchases and do not reduce rights attached to an existing order.

pages.content:
Where we ship
{{restrictions}}

Production and processing
Your item is printed after you order. Processing takes {{processing_time}} before shipment, starting on the next business day after successful payment. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays observed by the production facility and carrier. Orders placed on weekends or holidays begin processing on the next business day. Express shipping changes transit speed, not production time.

Shipping charges in US dollars
Standard: {{standard_first}} for the first item plus {{standard_additional}} for each additional item in the same order.
Express: {{express_first}} for the first item plus {{express_additional}} for each additional item in the same order.
We calculate shipping by total item quantity, not by the number of designs. Items may arrive in separate packages without an additional split-shipment fee. Your item total, selected shipping charge and applicable taxes are shown before payment.

Estimated transit after shipment
Standard: {{standard_transit}}.
Express: {{express_transit}}.
Add processing time to transit time for the total delivery estimate. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. Carrier disruptions, public holidays and peak demand may affect timing.

Tracking and delays
Contact {{support_email}} with your order reference for shipment or tracking help. Tracking may take time to show movement after the carrier receives a parcel. If we cannot ship within the stated processing period, we will notify you with a revised estimate and the option to cancel for a full refund. We will obtain your consent to a delay where required by law.

Missing, damaged or misdelivered orders
Email {{support_email}} if your order has not arrived by the latest estimated delivery date. We will review the delivery details and investigate with our fulfillment partner or carrier. If an order is confirmed lost in transit, you may choose a free replacement or a refund of the affected items, shipping and applicable tax. A delivery scan alone does not prevent you from reporting a missing parcel. For damage or an incorrect item, follow the 30-day reporting procedure in our Returns & Refunds policy.

Address corrections
Check your delivery address before paying. Contact us immediately if it needs a correction; we can change it before production starts, but changes after that point are not guaranteed. If a parcel is returned as undeliverable because of an address you entered incorrectly, we will explain the available options and any reshipping charge before you agree to it. We cover the cost when the addressing error was ours. This does not limit your statutory rights.

pages.content:
Where do you ship?

How much is shipping?
Standard shipping is {{standard_first}} for the first item and {{standard_additional}} for each additional item. Express shipping is {{express_first}} for the first item and {{express_additional}} for each additional item. Charges are in US dollars.

When will my order arrive?
Processing takes {{processing_time}}. After processing, estimated transit is {{standard_transit}} for Standard or {{express_transit}} for Express. Total delivery time includes processing and transit.

How do I choose a size?
Use the size guide for the garment you select. Check its measurements before ordering because fit can vary between styles.

Can I return or exchange an item?
{{returns_eligibility}}
{{returns_window}}
Read Returns & Refunds for the request process, fees and refund timing.

Can I change or cancel an order?
Email {{support_email}} as soon as possible. We can change or cancel an order before production starts. Once production begins, change-of-mind cancellations are not accepted and changes cannot be guaranteed. Your rights for faulty goods and shipping delays still apply. See our Terms of Service for details.

How do I contact TeeBravo?
Email {{support_email}}. Include your order reference when asking about an existing order. Do not include payment card details.
